messages:
marie: quick design callout — audit log search + KMS info. current table shows `encryption: true` but we don't show which key/alias or whether it's customer-managed. feels vague for customers and support. :thinking:

dennis: agree. users expect to filter by key alias and also see 'provider' (redwood-managed vs customer-kms). current filter dropdown only has 'Encrypted' / 'Unencrypted' which is too coarse. :eyes:

sarah: accessibility nit: the filter dropdown label is 'Encryption' but it's missing an accessible description for the state. screen readers read the dropdown as just 'Encryption collapsed'. we should add `aria-describedby` to explain options.

ralph: quick backend note — we have key alias data in the audit event payload, but it's currently sanitized for PII in some tenants. we can surface `key_alias` for enterprise customers on opt-in. implementation is straightforward but needs flag.

dennis: ok. UI suggestions: replace dropdown with two controls: a tri-state filter (Encrypted / Unencrypted / Any) and an optional second filter 'KMS key alias' free-text autocomplete. layout-wise put them inline above the table.

copybot: proposed copy for the KMS column tooltip:
```
Encrypted with: Customer-managed key (alias: alias/my-app-prod) — visible if tenant opted in.
If not shown, this system uses Redwood-managed encryption.
```

marie: love that. can we shorten for table cell fallback? maybe show `Encrypted · customer key` or `Encrypted · redwood key` and tooltip has full text.

copybot: shorter cell text options:
- `Encrypted · customer key`
- `Encrypted · redwood key`

sarah: also ensure the table headers have `scope="col"` and that the tooltip trigger is keyboard-focusable. keyboard users should be able to reach the tooltip via tab.

ralph: noted. i'll add an API flag and a feature gate. estimated 2 sprints for full rollout (flag + UI + e2e). can we soft-launch with tooltip only? that would avoid the feature flag initially.

marie: yes soft-launch with tooltip first. dennis, can you sketch the inline filters + small responsive behavior (mobile collapses to 'Filters' drawer)? also add accessible labels for both controls.

dennis: will do. i'll drop updated Figma by EOD and include copy variants. pinging @sarah for a quick a11y pass once uploaded. :white_check_mark:

marie: thanks all. one more tiny copy nit: in audit detail view the event label currently says `kmsId` — change to `Key ID` and add hover text: `Key ID: the cryptographic key used to encrypt this object`

copybot: suggested hover copy: `Key ID (customer): the key alias or identifier used to encrypt this resource. Displayed only for customers who have enabled customer-managed keys.`

sarah: perfect. also add role="status" announcements for success/failure when filters are applied so screen reader users get feedback.

marie: great. i'll file the design ticket with those todos and link to this thread. thanks everyone :heart:
